verdict.rationale: Factory's docs explicitly state that Droid exec 'uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation,' directly matching the story, and related evidence (approval prompts, diff review before merge, bash mode toggle) supports configurable oversight levels. However, the pack lacks detail on how many tiers exist, how an engineering-lead would configure/enforce autonomy policy org-wide, or independent verification of the feature in practice. Missing for 10: concrete tier definitions/admin-level policy controls, independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomy tiers working as described.
